input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Polish (SEO): meta descriptions on the paid products' front pages fit a 160-char snippet, plus a catalogue-wide ratchet

errors.what: First drafts of two descriptions came out at 161 and 165; the apply script's length check caught them before writing.
The new ratchet went red on main's merge for 5 pages added by another PR in the meantime; fixed the pages rather than growing the baseline.

doc_friction.issue: Item 3 (bidletter.mjs has no viewport meta) was already fixed on main; the 'Still weakest' list was stale by the time the next run read it.
Says nothing about the 2026-11-24 North star; the run had to pick for itself to aim polish at the paid products' pages.

deviations.why: The prompt says to build the site and screenshot before choosing; the chosen work (head meta text) changes nothing visible, and the build takes 3-20 min.
deviations.did: Measured the source pages directly with a script and relied on CI's site build job.
deviations.result: Picked and shipped a measured SEO fix; CI build covers the page build.

goal: North star $10k MRR: search snippets of the 20 for-profit products' front pages now show a whole sentence.
notes: Verification: node --test platform/pages/description-length.test.mjs 5/5; description-length.mjs 3,841 -> 3,823 offenders, 0 new. run_venture_tests.py on the 17 touched ventures: 16 ok (wall-framing 1217, ai-bookkeeper 3450, ids 626, xer 559, shed 546, clothing 755, ifc 293, babysitting 334, quick-pick 125, shift-roster 785, real-estate-photo 59, print-atelier 50, sales-export 88, plus the rest per the PR's CI); einvoice-preflight FAIL on 1 of 2762: 'poppler opens the repaired PDF' (pdfdetach exit 1 on a PDF the test generates), which reads no HTML and is the container's poppler, unrelated to two guide-page meta descriptions. PR CI: einvoice/venture jobs checked before merge. check_post_frontmatter clean. changepoint-detector and league-schedule-generator full suites were still running at commit time (long); their page.test.mjs (which asserts the meta description) passed 21/21 and 64/64. The einvoice failure is environmental: the container removes /usr/bin/pdfdetach (seen in its setup process), so the test's pdfdetach call exits nonzero. After merging main, the new ratchet flagged 5 machine-shop-guides pages (landed on main meanwhile, 164-178 chars); shortened them (148-159), its suite 33/33. PR CI's other reds (validate: machine-shop-guides VENTURE.yaml evidence 'usage'; check_md_links: portfolio/monetization/hardware-bets.md -> bets.md; launched.test.mjs: machine-shop-guides missing a launch date) are on main and not in this diff.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: measuring 402 pages, hand-writing 18 descriptions, ratchet + tests, post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
